text:
Cass: quick sync  experiment for the pricing page ahead of the webinar. goal: test an email-first quote path + compact plan cards + micro-FAQ. route intent to sales differently.
Ravi: short hypothesis?
Cass: asking for email early (email-quote) vs inline estimate will lift qualified demo scheduling and increase MQL quality.
June: idea  replace tariff matrix with 3 compact cards, each shows 3 benefit bullets and 'ballpark per-month' placeholder. CTA variants: 'Estimate cost' vs 'Email me a quote'.
Alex: two estimator modes: INLINE = tokens input + concurrency selector -> instant ballpark (client-only), EMAIL = 2-field modal (email + company size) that sends quote via HubSpot. both approximate.
Ravi: client-only calc snippet: `const ballpark = Math.ceil(tokens/1000) * pricePerK + concurrency * seatAdj;` note rounding to protect from being too specific.
June: tracking: add hidden `experiment_id=pack_clarity_2026`, `utm_experiment=pack_clarity_may`, and events `quote_open`, `quote_run`, `quote_submit`, `plan_cta_click`. tie to HubSpot contact fields.
HubSpotBot: FYI I will append tag `experiment=pack_clarity_2026` on contact create and can trigger `hs_task` when `lead_score>=58`. confirm threshold.
Maya: 58 ok. Sales wants notification payload `notify=sales-eng@redwood.com` and `route=#sales-inbound` in webhook.
Alex: accessibility: modal traps focus, inputs have labels, sliders keyboard-friendly, ARIA live region for estimate changes.
June: micro-FAQ (collapsed) Qs: "How are tokens billed?", "Do you offer reserved capacity?", "Is data private?" answers = one sentence + 'learn more' links.
Cass: split plan labels test: Variant A descriptive (Launch / Scale / Shield), Variant B persona (Dev / Product / Platform). pick both for A/B.
Ravi: rollout: copy freeze today 3pm, dev Wed, QA Thu, soft launch Fri 10% traffic, monitor Sat-Sun, ramp Mon. webinar Tue.
June: metrics: primary = demo-scheduler CTR from page; secondary = email-quote request rate, MQL rate, revenue-weighted leads. segment by region (US/EU) and org_size.
Alex: ACTIONS: Cass finalize microcopy (today), Ravi build inline estimator + accessibility (Wed), June configure HubSpot hidden fields & UTMs, Maya draft sales micro-brief + outreach snippets, HubSpotBot test hs_task creation at threshold 58.
Cass: unless objections i'll push to staging tonight. :rocket:
